summary: Plan paid search and social campaigns, check tracking and report results. Review the course details and enquire about paid media training.
lede: Paid media training helps digital marketers, campaign managers and analysts plan and evaluate paid search and social campaigns. Using Google Ads and Meta Ads as the context, you’ll practise mapping keywords and audiences, allocating test budgets, checking UTM and conversion signals, and interpreting measures such as conversions and cost per conversion. The exercises support campaign planning and evidence-based recommendations for budget owners, while accounting for measurement limitations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who plan, run or report paid search and paid social campaigns. It is suitable for professionals building a reliable campaign workflow or improving how they explain media spend and results to colleagues.
prerequisites: Specific entry prerequisites were not supplied with the course facts. Familiarity with digital marketing objectives is useful; access to advertising accounts is not assumed for the planning and diagnostic exercises.
